text:
tara_cs: During renewal reviews I keep seeing accounts with clean timelines but hidden drift: low feature adoption + stale healthscore notes. Thinking we should run a weekly "renewal risk pulse" that combines telemetry sparsity + healthscore trend + last_success_call_age and surfaces top accounts to CSMs.
leo_manager: Good call. We need prioritization for renewal plays. Can the pulse output a risk band (low/med/high) and suggested next step (reachout, enablement, executive sponsor)?
minji_data: Proposed model inputs: healthscore_slope_30d, telemetry_events_14d, last_success_call_days, product_feature_adoption_pct, support_tickets_30d. Scoring: weighted z-score normalized, then bucketed. High risk if score > 2.0 or telemetry_events < 2 and healthscore_drop > 15.
owen_ops: Ops flow: weekly job computes rankings -> writes crm.field renewal_pulse = {band} and creates playbook_task if band=high. We'll also add crm.note with top 3 signals. Add allowlist for accounts in active executive engagement.
mika_devex: Playbook side: add "Renewal pulse" play that runs Monday mornings, posts top 50 high-risk to #cs-renewal with CSV and a playbook shortcut: [Start Renewal Outreach]. Shortcut opens modal with templated sequences and recommended owner. Include dry_run first.
pulsebot: renewal-pulse scheduled: cron=0 5 * * MON, mode=dry_run, sample_policy=top_by_risk, sample_limit=100
tara_cs: UX asks: CSM should see the signals inline in CRM (e.g., "telemetry sparse: 1 event in 14d"), plus a one-click "launch outreach" that creates tasks and stamps the timeline.
leo_manager: Approval/exemptions: if an account is in renewal negotiations, it should be excluded. Add crm.tag renewal_in_negotiation to skip pulse. Any manual overrides should be auditable.
minji_data: Metrics to track: weekly high-risk count, conversion to renewal_loss at 90 days, outreach conversion rate (did outreach reduce score by next pulse), and false-positive rate determined by CSM feedback. I'll log all signals for training.
owen_ops: Implementation plan and ETA: 1) scoring job + exporter (3 days), 2) CRM writeback + task creation (2 days), 3) playbook modal + Slack post + canary (2 sprints). We'll start canary with 150 accounts.
mika_devex: We'll include an optional A/B: auto-create tasks for canary vs manual-review for control. Also capture CSM quick feedback (useful/not useful) via slack button.
pulsebot: dry_run output: s3://redwood-cs/renewal-pulse/dryrun/2026-03-21.csv, high_risk=18, med_risk=42
tara_cs: Let's do 3 dry-run cycles, review metrics, then enable canary. Owners: owen_ops (implementation), minji_data (model + metrics), mika_devex (playbook UX), leo_manager (policy). Thanks all :thumbsup:
